title: Seems to work ok
text:
Seems to work ok. Pro: Seemed to work as it filled up liquid.
Con: The top is kinda flimsy, a portion of it broke off prior to emptying it, looks still usable though.
Refills are kinda pricey.
Check Home Depot and save some money on Kit and Refills.

product_metadata.title: DampRid Drop Starter Kit with 2 Fragrance Free Moisture Absorbing Tabs –Odor Eliminator for Fresher, Cleaner Air, 2 Count, White, 15 Ounces
features: OUR FASTEST ACTING MOISTURE ABSORBER: DampRid Reusable Moisture Absorber with Fragrance Free Drop-In Tab is designed to go to work immediately, attracting and trapping excess moisture, eliminating musty odors, and creating fresher, cleaner air.
DROP-IN TAB TECHNOLOGY: 360-degree ventilation system enhances airflow and maximizes moisture absorbing surface area for a fast acting solution.
REUSABLE DESIGN: Refills are fast, easy, and mess free. One starter Drop-In Tab is included. Refill packs sold separately.
NON-ELECTRIC REUSABLE DEHUMIDIFIER: Acts like a non-electric dehumidifier, perfect for bathrooms, laundry rooms, closets, living spaces, basements, and other areas where excess moisture is a problem.

EASY TO USE: Simply insert an unwrapped tab into the top container. The drop-in tab will collect moisture out of the air and deposit it into the moisture collection reservoir for septic-safe toilet disposal.
description: DampRid Reusable Moisture Absorber with Drop-In Tab attracts and traps excess moisture, eliminating musty odors. Our fastest acting moisture absorber, the 360-degree ventilation system enhances airflow to eliminate excess moisture quickly. Without using electricity, DampRid Drop-In Tablets absorb excess moisture to create and maintain optimal humidity levels wherever moisture is a problem in the home or office. To use, simply insert an unwrapped tablet into the reusable moisture collection units. When the moisture collection reservoir is full and the tablet has dissolved, pour out the liquid and insert a refill tablet (Fresh Scent and Fragrance Free refills sold separately). DampRid moisture absorbers are ideal for use in the bathroom, laundry room, closet, basement, or storage area – anywhere damp, stagnant air is a problem. Not for use in moving vehicles. Keep out of reach of children. Read and follow all label directions.
